citation: Zheng et al., Judging LLM-as-a-Judge with MT-Bench and Chatbot Arena, NeurIPS 2023
contains: Derived public labels and IDs only; no prompts, responses or private user material.
deduplication_policy: One vote per (question_id, turn, canonical model pair, judge); identical repeated labels are deduplicated; conflicting labels raise ValueError.
human_vote_aggregation: Unique modal label among A/B/tie (plurality); any tie for the largest vote count becomes tie. Includes both author_* and expert_* annotators.
order_diagnostics: The source contains a combined GPT-4 judgment, not its separate order-specific votes. input_reversed is source ordering versus canonical ordering, not a position-bias estimate.
tie_policy: Both tie and tie (inconsistent) map to tie; the latter flag is retained.
